hooks.name: Check Environment
hooks.description: Runs setup_env.py in quiet mode to make sure .venv exists and dependencies are installed. Silent when everything is already in place. Works on macOS/Linux and Windows.

hooks.name: Load Steering Files
hooks.description: Loads all steering files with inclusion: auto at session start.
